settings_updates_purpose: How Lodestar finds and installs new versions. Checking for updates contacts GitHub.
settings_updates_load_failed: Update information couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
settings_updates_unavailable: This installation has no update engine ({reason}). Updates are managed outside Lodestar.
settings_updates_part_failed: Release notes and history couldn't load.
settings_updates_error_check: The check didn't go through. Nothing has changed. Try again in a minute.
settings_updates_error_pause: The pause wasn't saved. The last state shown is still the server's.
settings_updates_error_skip: Skipping wasn't saved. The release can still install.
settings_updates_error_clear: The history wasn't cleared. It may still be there after a restart.
settings_updates_error_setting: The change wasn't saved. The choice shown is the one Lodestar is using.
settings_updates_error_locked: That setting is set outside the app, so it wasn't changed.
settings_updates_error_stale: The settings changed elsewhere. They were reloaded; make your change again.
settings_updates_error_load: Part of this page couldn't be refreshed. What's shown is the last the server said.
settings_updates_skip_body: It will never install automatically. A newer release is still offered.
settings_updates_rolled_back: The last update to {version} didn't work and was rolled back. {reason}
settings_updates_rolled_back_next: You're running the version that worked. Check the history below, then decide whether to try again.
settings_updates_contacts: Checking for updates contacts GitHub. Off never does, unless you press Check now.
settings_updates_mode_off_help: Lodestar never contacts GitHub. Check now still works when you press it.
settings_updates_mode_notify_help: You'll be told about new releases. Nothing installs without you, unless you turn on Always install security fixes.
settings_updates_mode_auto_help: Lodestar installs releases at your chosen level, inside the install window.
settings_updates_mode_image_help: Use this if Unraid's auto-update or Watchtower updates the image.
settings_updates_level_fixes_help: Bug and security fixes. No data migrations.
settings_updates_level_features_help: May migrate data, with a snapshot first, or rebuild the search index in the background.
settings_updates_level_all_help: Includes major releases. Releases that need manual steps still wait for you.
settings_updates_security_help_auto: Security releases install automatically, without waiting.
settings_updates_security_help_notify: Turning this on installs security releases without asking you first.
settings_updates_locked: Set by {variable}. Change it there; this screen can't.
settings_updates_locked_read_only: This setting can't be changed in the app.
settings_updates_cannot_not_supervised: Lodestar isn't running under a supervisor that can restart it. Run it as a service or in a container.
settings_updates_cannot_noexec: Your data volume is mounted noexec, so downloaded updates can't run. Remount it without noexec.
settings_updates_cannot_not_writable: The install folder is read-only. Make it writable, or use Container image updates.
settings_updates_cannot_package_managed: A package manager installed Lodestar. Update it with the package manager.
settings_updates_cannot_image_mode: Container image updates are on, so the image does the updating.
settings_updates_cannot_trust_damaged: The update trust data is damaged. See the notice above.
settings_updates_cannot_channel_unavaila: The update channel isn't available right now.
settings_updates_cannot_not_built_yet: Self-updating isn't built into this version yet.
settings_updates_notice_unknown_body: The server reported this notice, and this version of the screen has no explanation for it.
settings_updates_notice_revoked_key: Installed under a revoked signing key
settings_updates_notice_revoked_key_body: The key that signed this version has been revoked. Install a newer release as soon as one is offered.
settings_updates_notice_trust_damaged_bo: New installs are blocked until it's fixed. Restore the update folder from a backup or reinstall.
settings_updates_notice_clock_behind_bod: It looks behind. Update checks depend on the time, so set the clock correctly.
settings_updates_notice_clock_ahead_body: It looks ahead. Update checks depend on the time, so set the clock correctly.
settings_updates_notice_updater_unreadab: Saved update state couldn't be read
Automatic updates are held. Pausing or resuming saves a new state and ends the hold.
settings_updates_notice_held_in_process_: A pause couldn't be saved, so installs are held until Lodestar restarts, or until a pause or resume saves.
settings_updates_notice_check_not_saved_: Its time won't survive a restart. Lodestar will check again.
settings_updates_notice_pending_unwritab: The update files can't be written, so a new version can't be confirmed.
settings_updates_notice_bad_overlay_body: Lodestar is running the version it started with.
settings_updates_notice_manifest_lapsed: The release list is out of date
settings_updates_notice_manifest_lapsed_: Lodestar can't confirm newer releases until a check succeeds.
settings_updates_notice_channel_unavaila: Releases can't be found on the channel you follow.
settings_updates_releases_none: No newer release. This list shows what the last check found.
settings_updates_clear_body: The list of past updates is deleted. Installed versions aren't affected.
settings_updates_adv_channel_beta_help: Pre-releases, and the stable releases too.
settings_updates_adv_channel_nightly_hel: Built every day from the main branch. For testing only.
settings_updates_adv_switch_stable: Stable gets version releases only. Lodestar never goes back to an older version, so it waits for the next release on Stable.
settings_updates_adv_switch_beta: Beta gets pre-releases, which are tested less than Stable. A change may need a restore from a snapshot.
settings_updates_adv_switch_nightly: Nightly builds are made every day from the main branch and are for testing only. They can break, and a change may need a restore from a snapshot.
settings_updates_adv_switch_when: The change is saved now and applies to the next check.
settings_updates_adv_wait: Days to wait after a release
settings_updates_adv_wait_help: A release waits this many days before it installs automatically, 0 to 14. Security fixes don't wait.
settings_updates_adv_window_help: When automatic installs may happen, as HH:MM-HH:MM in the server's local time, for example 02:00-05:00.
settings_updates_adv_reindex_help: Lets an automatic update install a release that rebuilds the search index in the background.
settings_updates_adv_notify_help: Saved now. Messages are sent once notification channels are set up.
settings_updates_adv_notify_failure: When an update fails or is rolled back
